rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the joint sitting of Parliament on 14 June 2005 President Mbeki said he had concluded that it would be best to release Jacob Zuma (printed 'the Hon Jacob Zuma') from his responsibilities as Deputy President of the Republic and Member of the Cabinet.
